translations.web: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
translations.bsb: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
translations.kjv: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
translations.asv: They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for want of the fruits of the field.
